[Arnaav Sareen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arnaavsareen/) is an engineer and builder working at the intersection of
artificial intelligence and industry. He studied computer science and applied economics at
[Cornell University](https://www.cornell.edu/), where he captained the d1 men's
[Varsity Squash](https://cornellbigred.com/sports/mens-squash/roster/2024-25) team.
He's currently at [Axle (YC S22)](https://www.axle.insure/), building the clearinghouse for insurance.
Before that, he was a fellow at [The Residency](https://www.livetheresidency.com/), building
[SIFT](https://www.siftaitechnologies.com/) for industry 4.0 with the goal of growing it into the
ai operating system for factories. He's most excited about building at the frontier, especially
self-healing software. When he's not working or training, arnaav's interests span art, history,
[Fantasy Premier League](https://www.fplaiinsight.com) strategy, and the enduring hope that comes
with supporting [Tottenham Hotspur](https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/). If you'd like to learn more,
feel free to [contact him](mailto:arnaav24sareen@gmail.com).
